programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Set in a dugout in Aisne in 1918, it is the story of a group of British officers as they await their fate.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis: Men of Courage
programme.desc: The harrowing tale of American heroes shipwrecked in shark-infested waters in the waning days of WWII.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: Suspenseful, action packed and starring Blade's Wesley Snipes. When a team of highly trained operatives find the bloody corpses of a missing team in an isolated military compound, they begin investigating, but find themselves trapped inside. Soon encountering a strange supernatural phenomenon, it becomes clear that the compound itself is a sentient entity, harbouring deadly secrets of its own.

programme.title: Here Are The Young Men
programme.desc: A gritty Irish thriller based on Rob Doyles best-selling book. Starring Anya Taylor-Joy (The Queens Gambit), Dean Charles Chapman (1917), Travis Fimmel (Vikings) and Finn Cole (Peaky Blinders). Dublin teens Matthew, nihilistic Rez and the deranged Kearney leave school to a social vacuum of drink and drugs, falling into shocking acts of transgression that will irrevocably change their lives.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Described as Donnie Darko meets Lost and from legendary production company Blumhouse. After the tragic death of his father, millennial Toby (Logan Miller: Escape Room) is begrudgingly enrolled in a program where he must spend time on a remote island. After meeting mysterious Madeleine (Kristine Froseth: The Society), Toby realises neither of them are safe and something bloodthirsty is lurking.

programme.title: A Young Man with High Potential
programme.desc: This shocking, controversial horror thriller sees an uptight man succumb to his inner desires. Piet is a socially awkward, lonely and reclusive student, who catches up on classes online. This changes when he is forced to partner a project with new student Klara. Soon he becomes fixated with her. After his advances are rebuffed, he starts down a dark and despicable path.

programme.title: Dark Crimes
programme.desc: From the executive producers of The Revenant, Jim Carrey commands the screen in this spellbinding thriller. When a disgraced detective Tadek notices the stark similarities between a murder case and a crime novel written by Kozlow (Marton Csokas), he sees an opportunity to redeem his career. Digging deeper Tadek is soon caught up in a game of cat and mouse, that will reveal a dark truth! Gripping!

programme.title: The Burial
programme.desc: When a handshake deal goes sour, a funeral home owner enlists a charismatic attorney to help save his family business. Tempers flare and laughter ensues as the unlikely pair bond while exposing corporate corruption and racial injustice.

programme.title: My New York Year
programme.desc: 1990s, New York City: A recent grad and aspiring writer lands a job as assistant to renowned writer J.D. Salinger's literary agent.

programme.title: The Assistant
programme.desc: An assistant to a powerful movie mogul grows increasingly aware of the questionable behaviour of her boss toward her female peers.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream. Melissa Winters (Watts) works as a cashier at the bleak local convenience store...

programme.title: The Nine Lives Of Christmas
programme.desc: (2014) Festive romance with Brandon Routh and Kimberley Sustad. A committed bachelor and a busy vet student have no time for love. But will the arrival of a stray tabby lead to the purr-fect romance?

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie is the proud owner of the perfect Christmas getaway destination. Will her blossoming relationship with a guest end when she discovers his ulterior motive for staying at Holly Lodge? (2017)

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Planner
programme.desc: (2017) Romantic drama with Jocelyn Hudon. A woman is hired to plan her cousin's elaborate wedding and things are going perfectly - until a handsome stranger arrives asking questions about the groom.

programme.title: Memories Of Christmas
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance with Christina Milian. Noelle returns to her hometown to inherit her Christmas obsessed late mother's house. Can she rediscover her love of the season and maybe more?

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: The perfect world of a beautiful Seattle television reporter is shattered by the prediction of her death in seven days.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Rosie and Alex have been best friends since age six. As they dream of travelling the world, they decide to leave their small British town for Boston together to attend university. But fate has other plans...

programme.title: Standing Up for Sunny
programme.desc: An isolated guy with cerebral palsy is railroaded into helping an unassertive comedienne, and finds love and acceptance through stand up comedy.

programme.title: Scarborough
programme.desc: In a once-glamorous Scarborough hotel, away from prying eyes, two couples come to terms with the impossibility of their forbidden love.

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Starring Jaime Ray Newman, Michael Shanks, and Conan Graham. At Christmas, the tables turn on a selfless single mom when a local radio station takes over her love life after an innocent call from her 8-year-old son.

programme.title: Christmas Matchmakers
programme.desc: Two hard-working executive assistants arrange for their bosses to fall in love during the holidays.

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: When Vanessa returns home for Christmas, her name comes up for a huge promotion back at work! She is torn between taking the job or staying home to take over the family clinic, while her visit has rekindled an old romance as well.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina moves into her friend's suite at The Chesterton Hotel as she waits for her divorce settlement to come through on Christmas Day. While there, she starts a whirlwind romance with a billionaire, who proposes to her.

programme.title: My Birthday Romance
programme.desc: A woman tired of her parents nagging her to find a boyfriend makes a deal with a guy who also doesn't want a relationship to pose as her boyfriend to keep her family off her back until after her birthday party.

programme.title: My One True Love
programme.desc: When 2 of the 3 things a fortune teller predicts come true, Ali wonders about the 3rd - finding true love with a man named John. Drawn to a fireman whose name isn't John, does she trust destiny or her heart?

programme.title: Cooking With Love
programme.desc: In the running for a promotion, reality cooking show producer Kelly prepares for her cooking show for kids. When show host Chef Betty has an unexpected injury, Kelly hires controversial Chef Stephen as a replacement.

programme.title: Love by Accident
programme.desc: After breaking down on a road trip with her godmother, a woman enlists her mechanic to be her fake boyfriend, but soon their fake relationship isn't so fake after all.

programme.title: Mommy's Little Princess
programme.desc: Lizzy is adopted and discovers she is related to a royal German family.

programme.title: Lonnie/Rulon/Stanley
programme.desc: Lonnie plays dead for four agonizing hours.

programme.title: Mommy's Little Angel
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Katie has had a short but rough life.

programme.title: Mommy's Little Girl
programme.desc: Sadie, 11, reunites with mom for happiness. Stars Fiona Gubelman, Emma Hentschel.

programme.title: Mommy's Little Princess
programme.desc: Lizzy is adopted and discovers she is related to a royal German family.

programme.title: Deadly Vows
programme.desc: Pastry chef Helena poisons men who don't meet her standards, but Helena's fiancé's sister smells danger.

programme.title: Wish You Were Dead
programme.desc: Hayley Udall tries to make ends meet for herself and her 14 year-old daughter while providing alimony for a horrible ex-husband. She wishes her problems with her ex could go away, and upon venting her frustrations one night, finds herself tangled up in a pact with two people (Melanie and Kevin) to “eliminate” each other's problems.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori is cooking for girls night and must figure out how to please both of her friends!

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori gets breast revision surgery and throws a party to raise awareness for breast health. Time for a Booby Bash!

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: Widowed doctor Jessica vacations in Fiji with her daughter and finds love with resort owner Will.

programme.title: Dying for a Baby
programme.desc: A couple is threatened when Jessica, the driver from their past accident, moves in next door seeking revenge.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: Ray (Tanner Presswood) and Paul (Simon Elias) are best friends and co-best men in their buddy's wedding. But when they lose the ring just days before the wedding, their fateful road trip to get it back accelerates into a loud exploration of life, love, and how to not die.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Fueled by caffeine and machismo, a rivalry ensues between Nick and Russell. The one-upmanship becomes a contest of wits and wills, where stress is the great equalizer and bravado is the lowest common denominator...

programme.title: A Little White Lie
programme.desc: When a handyman living in New York City is mistaken for a famous and famously reclusive writer, he's brought to a university where he is to deliver a keynote address to save the school's literary festival.

programme.title: Good Luck Chuck
programme.desc: Meet Charlie Logan, he's a good luck charm and women are guaranteed to find true love after they sleep with him. But what seems like a blessing feels like a curse when he meets Cam, the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Pray to God and Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: Fernando returns from exile in Texas seeking revenge for his siblings' deaths. But instead of personal vengeance, he's driven to spark a revolution against the oppressive landowners, transforming his mission into a fight for justice and freedom.

programme.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang Rides Again
programme.desc: Retired Texas Ranger Nash Crawford re-assembles his former Ranger outfit from the old days to fight crime in his hometown.

programme.title: Drums in the Deep South
programme.desc: Best friends Clay Clayburn and Will Denning graduate from West Point before the Civil War forces them onto opposing sides. Unaware they face each other in battle, they risk becoming enemies on the battlefield. Meanwhile, Kathy Summers, who cares deeply for both men, desperately tries to prevent a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: Dangerous Exile
programme.desc: The young Dauphin of France takes refuge in a Welsh town during the French Revolution.

programme.title: Conspiracy of Hearts
programme.desc: Italian nuns secretly help children escape German troops during World War II.

programme.title: Caesar and Cleopatra
programme.desc: Vivien Leigh stars as Cleopatra in this lavish historical drama.

programme.title: House of Secrets
programme.desc: A plot to flood Britain with counterfeit notes is discovered by the CIA in Paris.

programme.title: Fountain of Youth
programme.desc: While Nigel rehearses his keynote speech in a Seville hotel room, a girl nearly breaks his nose demanding something - it turns out she was after the water from the Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Arthurs Cross
programme.desc: Scotland Yard calls Sidney and Nigel to identify a 5th century murder weapon. It turns out to be the burial cross of King Arthur, but besides the victim several others are looking for it.

programme.title: So Shall It Be
programme.desc: When Sidney and Nigel are about to enter the site of a Bristol lecture, a young author approaches them to follow up immediately on a tip about a map to the lost keys to the druid cult in Stonehenge.

programme.title: Buddhas Bowl
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Nepal to recover Buddha's fabled overflowing alms bowl for villagers who are building a shrine to the original Buddha.

programme.title: The Headless Nun
programme.desc: When Sydney's plane crashes, she's asked by a group of nuns to find the head of another nun who was decapitated several centuries ago.

programme.title: Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel search for Al Capone's diamond-encrusted gun at the behest of a man hoping it will clear his grandfather of a murder he was framed for.

programme.title: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Scotland to find the second ring of the pair of Twining Rings of Calum and Elena.

programme.title: Thank You Very Much
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Germany to find a lost Elvis Presley guitar.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: Gunner
programme.desc: When ruthless drug traffickers kidnap his children, ex-special forces operative Lee Gunner embarks on a violent life-or-death mission. With his unique skills and nothing to lose, he'll take on an army to bring his family home.

programme.title: Sleepless
programme.desc: When Las Vegas cop Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) and his partner Sean (Tip “T.I.” Harris) rob a cocaine shipment bound for a drug-dealing casino boss (Dermot Mulroney), the desperate businessman retaliates by kidnapping Vincent's son (Octavius J. Johnson

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: After a failed mission to capture the leader of a deadly gambling ring, bounty hunter Will Tanner becomes the hunted—a human target in a game in which contestants must kill or be killed.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: When Joe Braven, a humble logger residing along the U.S./Canada border, is confronted by a group of deadly drug runners in his secluded cabin in the mountains, he must do everything in his power to protect his family.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: When the human race is on the verge of extinction, one of the last survivors on earth, an extraordinary young woman, goes on a mission to track down her younger brother who was abducted by the extra-terrestial creatures colonizing earth.

programme.title: The Evil Dead (1983)
programme.desc: Five twentysomething friends are holed up in a remote cabin where they discover a Book Of The Dead. An archaeologist's tape recording reveals that the ancient text was discovered among the Khandarian ruins of a Sumerian civilization. Playing the taped incantations, the youths unwittingly summon up dormant demons living in the nearby woods, which possess the youngsters in succession until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Lake Placid: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: A rogue game warden breaks out her guns after the schemes of an obsessed poacher lands a group of high school students into the midst of the man-eating crocodile nature preserve.

programme.desc: A trio of friends break into the house of a wealthy blind man, thinking they 'll get away with the perfect heist. They 're wrong.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Guns Of Redemption [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A scarred gunslinger tries leaving violence behind, but his past catches up. Near death from an ambush, he straps on his guns for one final mission.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen ("Green Book") stars as an undercover FBI agent who has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Avalanche (1999)
programme.desc: The survivor of an Alaskan avalanche, Dr. Lia Freeman (Caroleen Feeney) is an environmentalist concerned about a similar disaster occurring if a proposed new oil pipeline is built. Freeman adamantly warns the planners of the likelihood of a major avalanche, but they ignore her pleas. As she realizes that a massive whiteout is imminent, Freeman tries to get the citizens of a nearby town to leave, aided by brave helicopter pilot Neal Meekin (Thomas Ian Griffith).

programme.title: Val Jane : 12 heures pour sauver sa vie
programme.desc: Val est prise en otage avec ses enfants par Denny, un homme qui s'est introduit de force dans sa maison après avoir commis un meurtre.

programme.title: Zoe, maman solo
programme.desc: Zoe, célibataire, tombe enceinte grâce à une insémination artificielle. Les choses se compliquent lorsque deux hommes entrent dans sa vie.

programme.title: Un mariage à Yosemite
programme.desc: Zoe, une photojournaliste renommée, visite les paysages de Yosemite rendus célèbres par Ansel Adams.

programme.title: Un héritage maudit
programme.desc: Un jeune homme riche engage une aide-soignante apparemment parfaite pour prendre soin de sa mère malade.

programme.title: Un mari aux deux visages
programme.desc: Le mari d'une femme disparaît lors d'une excursion en kayak. Lorsqu'elle aperçoit un homme qui lui ressemble, sa vie est bouleversée.

programme.title: Harriet Craig
programme.desc: Harriet Craig runs a household, manipulating others in order to keep her place perfect, no matter the cost.

programme.title: A Man For All Seasons
programme.desc: Dramatic depiction of the conflit between Hentry VIII and Sir Thomas More.

programme.title: Easy Rider

programme.title: Charles Bradley
programme.desc: On April 26, 2012, the world-famous vocalist Charles Bradley and his Extraordinaires grace the stage of the Cigale in Paris. Success did not come easily for the American. Before Bradley (1948-2017) even considered a career as a singer, he tried to make ends meet with countless odd jobs. Only in 1996 he finally followed in the footsteps of his great idol, soul icon James Brown. Brown and Bradley shared the talent to bring an audience to ecstasy. With his mix of funk, soul, and R&B, Bradley has developed a sound of his own, in which a keen ear might find a few traces of James Brown.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti, George Gruntz, Steve Coleman & J.F. Clark
programme.sub-title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven's loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn's and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors. For instance, the work opens with a slow introduction that refuses to reveal the piece's key. Equally remarkable are the unusual prominence of the woodwinds, and the scherzo-like tempo of the third movement bearing the indication ‘minuet'. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Journey
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.desc: Ambientación del mito griego en el carnaval de Río de Janeiro. programme.desc: Agosto de 1941. El gobierno de Vichy crea una Sección Especial cuyo objetivo es la ejecución de chivos expiatorios para aplacar la ira de los nazis cuando algún oficial alemán es asesinado por la Resistencia. Las víctimas, cuatro comunistas y dos judíos elegidos aleatoriamente, serán juzgados por un tribunal corrompido. Un joven magistrado intenta hacer valer sus influencias políticas para conseguir el indulto.

programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.desc: Buñuel imagina una aventura en la que él, Lorca y Dalí emprenden la búsqueda de la mesa del rey Salomón.

programme.title: La casa de la esperanza
programme.desc: Una historia conmovedora basada en el hecho real más curioso de la II GM. El director del zoo de Varsovia y su esposa (Jessica Chastain), ayudaron a salvar a cientos de personas (y también a muchos animales del Zoo) de los nazis tras la invasión de Polonia por las tropas alemanas en 1939.

programme.title: Queen & Slim
programme.desc: Tras una ligera infracción de tráfico, un hombre (Daniel Kaluuya) y una mujer de color (Jodie Turner-Smith) que disfrutan de su primera cita, son parados por la policía.

programme.title: Dark Was the Night
programme.desc: En el remoto pueblo de Maiden Woods comienzan a sucederse una serie de sanguinarios crímenes. Unas extrañas huellas parecen señalar a algún tipo de animal como principal sospechoso. Mientras la población vive atemorizada por los acontecimientos, el Sheriff Paul Shield investiga el caso.

programme.title: El único superviviente
programme.desc: Espectacular adaptación cinematográfica de las memorias del ex-marine Marcus Luttrell en las que relata su experiencia en la misión de 2005 en Afganistán, donde le encomendaron liquidar a un líder terrorista en lo que se considera uno de los mayores actos de valor de la guerra moderna.

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: El profesor de filosofía Abe Lucas ha tocado fondo a nivel emocional y se ve incapaz de encontrarle ningún sentido ni alegría a su vida. Abe tiene la sensación de no haber marcado la más mínima diferencia con nada de lo que ha emprendido en su vida, desde el activismo político a la enseñanza.

programme.title: El profesor de Persa
programme.desc: Francia, 1942. Gilles es arrestado por soldados de las SS junto con otros judíos y enviado a un campo de concentración en Alemania. allí consigue evitar la ejecución al jurar a los guardias que no es judío, sino persa.

programme.title: Perdidos En El Sol
programme.desc: La historia de John, un delincuente de poca monta, que encuentra un inesperado cómplice en Louis, un adolescente que acaba de quedarse huérfano.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: Excelente y multipremiada cinta basada en hechos reales sobre la escalofriante historia de un profesor que, para explicar los regímenes autoritarios, idea un expermiento consistente en implantar un régimen de extrema disciplina militar en el aula. El experimento se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Fresa y chocolate
programme.desc: David es un comunista convencido que estudia sociología en la Universidad de La Habana. Diego es un artista homosexual acosado por la homofobia del régimen castrista. A pesar de las abismales diferencias que los separan, entre ellos surge una profunda amistad.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una empleada de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su manera franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, él la convence para que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: Visión
programme.sub-title: La historia de Hildegard Von Bingen
programme.desc: Hildegard tiene visiones desde niña en las que Dios le pide que transmita sus mensajes. Ahora es una monja y su fama traspasa los muros del convento. Una mujer adelantada a su época por su empleo de la medicina natural y por su talento como compositora. Una personalidad destacadísima de la sociedad medieval.

programme.title: Yo acuso
programme.desc: Viviendo en la comunidad agrícola de Rickerby, Kimberly Jantzen, de 24 años, es una madre soltera que trabaja en la gasolinera mientras estudia en la escuela de enfermería para buscar una vida mejor para ella y su hija. Una noche, en el pub local, se pelea con Billy, su ex novio. Con un corte en la mano, es tratada por el Dr. Richard Darian, una de las personas más ricas y respetadas de la ciudad. Sin embargo, bajo fuerte sedación, Kimberly está segura de que el médico abusó de ella.

programme.title: Uno tras otro
programme.desc: Nils es un tipo agradable de buenos modales que trabaja como conductor quitanieves en las montañas de Noruega. Cuando su hijo muere por una sobredosis de drogas, Nils se niega a creer en los resultados del informe policial. Él está convencido que su hijo fue asesinado y quiere venganza. Sus acciones desencadenan una violenta guerra entre la mafia serbia y el gánster local “El Conde”. Para un tipo corriente como Nils, ganar una batalla como ésta no es fácil, pero tiene algo en su favor: maquinaria pesada, la suerte del principiante y un talento extraordinario para la venganza.

programme.title: Tierra de sangre
programme.desc: En un centro penitenciario de máxima seguridad, el prisionero Thorne entabla una prohibida y peligrosa relación con su guarda, Joe. En forma de flashbacks, el recluso le detallará como pasó de ser un escritor teatral con éxito en un país totalitario a activista político, y como desde la posición de líder en la clandestinidad planificó derrocar al gobierno dictatorial siendo finalmente detenido y deportado.

programme.title: Llamada perdida
programme.desc: Yumi Nakamura es una estudiante que está con un grupo de amigos cuando su mejor amiga, Yoko, recibe una llamada a su móvil con un extraño tono que no había oído antes. En la pantalla aparece “Llamada perdida”. Cuando lo escucha, no solo parece venir de su propio número, sino que también contiene un terrible grito que suena exactamente igual que la voz de Yoko. Además, la llamada está fechada tres días después. Tres días más tarde, Yoko muere.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: La retorcidas mentes de dos de los seis guionistas de Scary Movie dan una vuelta de tuerca al género de la comedia romántica en DATE MOVIE.

programme.title: Una piraña en el bidé
programme.desc: Julia quiere que sus padres separados, vuelvan a juntarse. Para ello consigue que su padre y su niñera África, que viven juntos, se peleen, y que África conquiste a Alejo, el compañero de su madre. Pero su madre se ha enamorado de Jorge, con el que espera un hijo.

programme.title: Mi mejor amigo gay
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes, Michael y Matty, han sido amigos desde 3o de primaria. Aún vírgenes, hacen un pacto para perder la virginidad antes de su graduación, pero su amistad se pondrá a prueba, cuando uno de ellos sale del armario...

programme.title: Si fuéramos los últimos
programme.desc: A la deriva en su averiado transbordador espacial y con pocas esperanzas de ser rescatados, dos astronautas discuten si es mejor pasar los días que les quedan como amigos o algo más. El roce hace el cariño y las chispas cada vez van más en aumento…

programme.title: Ellas Dan El Golpe
programme.desc: La liga All-American de Béisbol Profesional femenino fue fundada en 1943, cuando la mayoría de los hombres que jugaban a béisbol estaban en Europa y Asia luchando en la Segunda Guerra Mundial. En los bosques de Oregón, dos hermanas, Dottie y Kit van a Chicago a probar para el equipo femenino. Gracias a su esfuerzo y al de las demás jugadoras el equipo empieza a mostrar cierta promesa, hasta que terminó la guerra y los hombres regresaron.

programme.title: El Hombre De La Casa
programme.desc: Cuando cinco alegres animadoras son testigo del asesinato de un confidente, requieren vigilancia las veinticuatro horas del día para evitar ser las siguientes víctimas. En eso que entra el duro Ranger de Texas, el teniente Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones), que se hace pasar por su segundo entrenador alojándose en el campus universitario. Pero estas enérgicas jovencitas solo quieren salir fiesta y el estirado Sharp aprende que no es un trabajo fácil mantener fuera de peligro a estas incontrolables estudiantes. Cedric the Entertainer se une a este fogoso reparto en una comedia llena de energía, orgullo y la alegría de un Ranger de Texas que se pone en contacto con su lado femenino.

programme.title: Juerga Hasta El Fin
programme.desc: Durante una fiesta celebrada en Los Angeles con motivo de la inauguración de la nueva casa de James Franco, los también actores Seth Rogen, Jay Baruchel y otras celebridades se enfrentan al Apocalipsis del fin del mundo pronosticado por los mayas.

programme.title: Ligas Mayores
programme.desc: La nueva propietaria de los Indians de Cleveland forma un equipo deliberadamente desastroso para que pierdan y así poder trasladar al equipo. Sin embargo, cuando su plan sale a la luz, los jugadores comienzan a ganar solo para fastidiarla.

programme.title: Se busca
programme.desc: En Nuevo México, la infeliz esposa de mediana edad de un sheriff ayuda a un preso condenado a escapar de la cárcel de su marido y se fuga con el joven y atractivo forajido a México, perseguido por la partida del sheriff.

programme.title: Entre Dios, el diablo y un arma
programme.desc: Un hombre accede al mapa de un tesoro y convence a un guía (Juan Chasquisdo) para que le acompañe en su búsqueda para recuperarlo. Ambos son perseguidos por bandidos.

programme.title: El tesoro del lago de plata
programme.desc: Tras el asalto a una diligencia y el asesinato de su padre, Fred Engel se une a Old Shatterhand y Winnetou para recuperar un mapa del tesoro dividido en dos. Su búsqueda los lleva hasta Silver Lake, donde deberán adelantarse a la banda del coronel Brinkley, decidida a hacerse con el oro.

programme.title: Pampa salvaje
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un capitán del ejército intenta domar las llanuras abiertas de Argentina, dominadas por los indios y los bandidos. Para ello, el capitán trae a un grupo de mujeres para mantener contentos a sus soldados.

programme.title: Amar sin miedo
programme.desc: Josh Adams explora su sexualidad y autodescubrimiento en Taxco, México. Al conocer al músico Leo, dos hombres de mundos distintos sienten una atracción inesperada que transformará sus vidas en este drama erótico y humano.

programme.title: Not Forgotten
programme.desc: En un pueblo fronterizo de Tex-Mex, un hombre y su mujer deben enfrentarse a sus torturados pasados para salvar a su hija secuestrada.

programme.title: Giros
programme.desc: Karla debe decidir entre emigrar con su familia o quedarse en Cuba y seguir su propio rumbo. Entre amistades, amores y dudas, enfrenta los giros del destino y encuentra el valor de elegir por sí misma. Una historia de identidad, libertad y coraje frente a decisiones que marcan la vida.

programme.title: Código Alfa: Conspiración
programme.desc: Johana, una mujer sin pasado, huye de Bowie, agente de la ONU y director de un programa espacial secreto. En su camino conoce a Martin y, con ayuda de Lance, intenta encontrar a la hija de Martin, mitad alienígena, explorando meditación, telepatía y frecuencias superiores.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Quién eres
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de María, una joven que busca formar parte de un grupo y que es bastante ingenua. Después de una gran discusión con su amiga Clara, decide pasar el rato hablando con Lucas, un hombre que ha conocido a través de internet y del que sabe más bien poco.

programme.title: Tierra firme
programme.desc: Dos mujeres, Eva y Kat, y el mejor amigo de una de ellas, Roger. Un barco en los canales de Londres y una pregunta: ¿Es posible vivir el amor, la familia, y la vida de formas tan distintas y aún así permanecer unidos?

programme.title: Noctem
programme.desc: Noches seguidas, Adrian se encuentra en su apartamento, sin luces y con sonidos extraños provenientes del interior. Pide ayuda a sus amigos y uno de ellos decide hacer un documental de lo que le está pasando.

programme.title: La vergüenza
programme.desc: Pepe y Lucía no pueden con Manu. Lo han intentado todo, pero es inútil: el niño que adoptaron hace apenas un año les viene grande, no se hacen con él, y han decidido devolverlo. Sin embargo pronto se dan cuenta del precio que deberán pagar si quieren seguir adelante con su plan.

programme.title: Viejos
programme.desc: Manuel tiene que mudarse a la casa de su hijo Mario y la familia de éste después de que un terrible suceso acabe con la vida de su anciana mujer. Poco a poco, la realidad se impone: algo incomprensible ocurre con Manuel.

programme.title: El caballero de las sombras
programme.desc: Todas las adolescentes del pueblo han desaparecido. Para resolver el misterio, el detective Fei se une al cazador de demonios Pu Songling, cuyos poderes le permiten invocar cadenas con forma de tentáculos con los que atrapa a los monstruos.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones internacionales liderado por Macao-Park se dispone a poner en marcha un plan maestro para dar el golpe del siglo en un casino. Pero como el honor no existe entre ladrones, cada uno de ellos organiza por separado su propio y personal plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: Amenaza terrorista
programme.desc: Ewan es un agente del Servicio Secreto cuya misión consiste en capturar y eliminar a Ash, un terrorista suicida, y a la célula a la que pertenece. Mientras tanto, Ash se enfrenta a un dilema moral.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de un despiadado jefe mafioso, un conductor que se da a la fuga después de un violento atraco deberá entregar a un joven miembro de la banda en una emboscada para ejecutarlo.

programme.title: Xxx 2: Estado De Emergencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela atiborrada de acción del éxito de taquilla xXx, Ice Cube interpreta a Darius Stone, un liante en busca de subidones cuyos antecedentes policiales y su obsesión por los deportes extremos le convierten en candidato ideal para ser el próximo agente xXx. Debe salvar a Estados Unidos de una conspiración letal del general de cinco estrellas y Secretario de Defensa George Deckert (interpretado por Willem Dafoe). Solo un renegado agente xXx como Stone tiene las habilidades extremas para evitar que el peligroso grupo disidente del ejército tome el gobierno en la capital de Estados Unidos.

A medida que la investigación se vuelve cada vez más peligrosa, se verán obligados a afrontar los pecados de su pasado, además de vérselas con las consecuencias paranormales de sus incursiones en el más allá....
